access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a white cotton dress with silk: a sheer pouched bodice with a lace yoke and high collar, elbow puffs, a white satin sash at the waist, the skirt with bands of insertion and small worked motifs near the hem. A real garment, French, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): the white lingerie dress.
what_it_supplies: the white summer dress of the years: sheer cotton, lace, insertion bands and a satin sash
what_it_does_not_supply: how any Prairie Avenue woman dressed, or the colour of any dress she owned
how often such a dress was worn on a Chicago street in 1904
